MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The construction adhesive felt like a useful next purchase because I repeatedly buy bonding and fastening supplies for workshop repairs involving wood and metal.",
    "The thermal imager connects to my inspection camera and infrared thermometer, while the vacuum chamber connects to my epoxy work. Both interest me, though I would need a specific use and compatible equipment.",
    "The pocket-hole screws fit my woodworking interests, but I would only choose them when a project needs that particular fastener."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The LEDs and electrical test leads assume an electrical project that my recent drilling, cutting, riveting, and fastening purchases do not establish.",
    "Crucible tongs relate broadly to metalworking, but working with metal does not mean I melt or cast it.",
    "Calibration weights and fine-needle syringes require specific tasks I have not shown a need for; owning a caliper or dropper bottles does not make those tasks likely."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations seem to treat workshop equipment as broadly interchangeable, even though fabrication, electrical testing, and casting serve different purposes.",
    "Buying measurement or inspection tools seems to have been taken as interest in any precision equipment, regardless of what I need to measure."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases repeatedly support practical assembly and repair through rivets, threaded inserts, bolts, screws, adhesives, and cutting tools.",
    "A related tool becomes useful when it solves a concrete project need. Thermal imaging requires device compatibility, and vacuum equipment needs to suit my resin work.",
    "I already own screw assortments, so another set needs a distinct purpose rather than simply resembling something I bought before."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my workshop interests but sometimes mistake a broad connection for a tool or supply I actually need next."
}
